From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

American academic

**John B. Buse** is the Verne S. Caviness Distinguished Professor of Medicine at the [University of North Carolina School of Medicine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_North_Carolina_School_of_Medicine "University of North Carolina School of Medicine") (UNC). He is also the director of UNC's Diabetes Care Center and the North Carolina Translational and Clinical Sciences Institute.[[1]](#cite_note-1)[[2]](#cite_note-2) In 2008, he held the position of President, Medicine & Science on the board of the [American Diabetes Association](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Diabetes_Association "American Diabetes Association") (ADA).[[3]](#cite_note-3)

## Biography

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=John_Buse&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Biography")]

Buse attended high school at [Porter-Gaud School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porter-Gaud_School "Porter-Gaud School") in [Charleston, South Carolina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charleston,_South_Carolina "Charleston, South Carolina").[[4]](#cite_note-4) He received his [bachelor's degree](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor's_degree "Bachelor's degree") in [biochemistry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biochemistry "Biochemistry") from [Dartmouth College](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dartmouth_College "Dartmouth College") and his MD and PhD from [Duke University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duke_University "Duke University"). He completed his internship and residency in [internal medicine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_medicine "Internal medicine") and his [fellowship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fellow_(medicine) "Fellow (medicine)") in [endocrinology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Endocrinology "Endocrinology") at the [University of Chicago](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Chicago "University of Chicago"). In 2019, Buse received the Outstanding Achievement in Clinical Diabetes Research Award from the ADA.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
